title: CREEPER ANTI LAG
description: Advanced anti-lag plugin featuring TNT protection, intelligent item cleanup, mob optimization, lag machine detection, and real-time TPS monitoring.
body:
# 🚀 Creeper Anti Lag

Keep your server fast, stable, and protected from common lag sources without complicated setup.

Creeper Anti Lag is a performance-focused optimization plugin designed to automatically detect, manage, and reduce server lag caused by TNT abuse, entity overload, lag machines, excessive mobs, dropped items, and large-scale explosions.

---

## ✨ Features

### 💥 TNT Protection Engine
- Monitors TNT activity in real time
- Prevents dangerous TNT growth and chain reactions
- Automatically limits excessive TNT during low TPS situations
- Helps protect servers from TNT-based lag attacks

### 🧹 Smart Item Cleanup
- Removes unnecessary dropped items automatically
- Reduces entity buildup over time
- Helps maintain stable server performance

### 🐄 Mob Optimization
- Controls excessive mob accumulation
- Per-chunk mob limits
- Prevents mob farms and accidental mob overload from harming TPS

### 💣 Explosion Optimization
- Dynamically reduces explosion impact during heavy lag
- Helps prevent massive explosions from overwhelming the server
- TPS-based protection system

### 🛡️ Lag Machine Detection
- Detects and removes dangerous minecart spam
- Monitors suspicious chunk activity
- Designed to combat common lag machine techniques

### 📊 Real-Time TPS Monitoring
- Continuously tracks server performance
- Automatically adjusts protection levels based on current TPS

### Performance Profiles
- 🟢 Normal
- 🟡 Warning
- 🟠 Critical
- 🔴 Emergency

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable
- Simple configuration
- Adjustable limits and protection settings
- Suitable for both small and large servers

---

## ✅ Supported Software

- Paper
- Purpur

---

## 🎮 Supported Minecraft Versions

- 1.21.x

---

## 🎯 Goal

Keep your server playable, responsive, and protected from common lag sources while requiring minimal maintenance from server owners.

Built for survival servers, SMPs, factions, minigames, and large communities that want reliable automatic performance protection.

---
